thread:
leah: Heads up 1: Aurora is asking for a hybrid POC (private deploy + hosted fallback) for 8 weeks. They want 40% off list for the POC + waived setup fee and $100k credit. Region: eu-west primary, us-west failover.

omar: 40% + $100k is big. Do we have signal on likely annualized spend post-POC? Need ARR expectations before pushing discount.

leah: They hinted at ~$2.5M ARR if POC proves perf/cost. Procurement is pushing hard on price.

nina: Our policy: sales can approve up to 25% for POCs for Enterprise segment. 25-35% requires RevOps + CRO sightline. >35% requires CRO approval and finance signoff.

cara: From infra: hybrid means private control plane in their VPC + hosted fallback. That increases ops risk/footprint; setup time ~3 weeks. Waiving setup fee not ideal.

leah: Suggested counter: 30% off for POC + $50k credit + conditional waiver of setup fee if they commit to 12m reserved capacity within 60 days after POC. Also add perf acceptance criteria (p99 latency < 150ms).

omar: I like conditional waiver. Also add a clause: if they don't commit, we bill retroactively for the waived setup and scale down credits.

nina: I'll need ARR justification and a one-pager on ROI to approve 30%. If they push 40%, I'll escalate to @cara-senior-cro (Jaya) and finance.

cara: Legal: include exit/rollback terms, IP/data residency certs, and a network runbook for the private env. No open-ended liability.

leah: I'll prepare two quote scenarios for the call: A) 30% + $50k credit + conditional setup waiver (12m commit 60d) B) 25% + $75k credit + no setup waiver. Ask: who is ok with sharing a brief competitor comp (they said another vendor offered 35%)?

omar: Share sanitized screenshot yes, helpful for escalation. Also request 72-hour perf window with their sample workload.

nina: I can approve scenario A provisionally once you attach ARR justification doc and expected start date. Anything beyond that route to CRO.

leah: I'll get the quote out (Q-2026-559) and attach ARR doc. Planning to push scenario A in customer call.

cara: I'll prep the runbook template and timeline. Ops note: label quote lines "requires revops" where needed.

deal-desk-bot: Policy check: discount_request=30%, escalation_needed=false (pending docs). Record ID=DD-2026-0783.

leah: Thanks team. I'll update after the customer demo tomorrow. :eyes:
